tests/Falah.Server.IntegrationTests/PayE.meaning: Tests standalone debit is typed Settlement, distinct from PayrollSettlement; no combined same-period payroll sequence.

tests/Falah.Server.IntegrationTests/Payr.meaning: Tests payroll batch payment and treasury movement separately; no standalone-then-payroll same-period combined sequence.
